source.provider: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
source.resampling: Bilinear at pixel centres; 129×129 latitude/longitude grid; local equirectangular metre approximation at centre latitude. Native source roughly 55m/pixel; export roughly 139m/grid interval.
source.limitations: Merged LINZ elevation visualisation; source age/resolution varies. Resampled for cartographic teaching, not terrain analysis, navigation or hazards. No buildings, trees, imagery or current snow/ice boundary. Maximum sample is not a surveyed summit elevation.
